src='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]; h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); bg=grid[0][0]
    marker=next(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg)
    for r in range(h):
        pts=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v==marker]
        for a,b in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
            for c in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    for c in range(w):
        pts=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==marker]
        for a,b in zip(pts,pts[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b): out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''
